anomalies.message: CPU load average is very high across all time intervals, nearing or exceeding the number of cores.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, indicating potential inactivity or malfunction.
Trading system shows no active trades and a win rate of 0, which could indicate a lack of trading activity or strategy issues.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is functioning correctly and generating opportunities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the active trading strategies to ensure they are aligned with current market conditions.

recommendations.action: Address the high CPU load immediately by identifying and optimizing or redistributing resource-heavy processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system to diagnose and resolve the lack of activity.
